questions.subject: Civil Engineering
questions.questionMarkup:
Froude’s number similarity is used when there is dominant action of gravity, typically in
(a) Structures subjected to free surface flow action.
(b) Hydraulic structure with free surface flow.
(c) Completely enclosed flow.
(d) Surface wave action as in break waters and harbours.
Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.questionText: Froude’s number similarity is used when there is dominant action of gravity, typically in (a) Structures subjected to free surface flow action. (b) Hydraulic structure with free surface flow. (c) Completely enclosed flow. (d) Surface wave action as in break waters and harbours. Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.explanationHtml:
(a, b, d)
Completely enclosed flow and flow in flow-meters in pipes are governed by Reynolds number similarity.

questions.subject: Civil Engineering
questions.questionMarkup: When a stone is dropped in an open channel flow, the ripples formed on the water surface indicate the type of flow. The flow will be supercritical when
questions.questionText: When a stone is dropped in an open channel flow, the ripples formed on the water surface indicate the type of flow. The flow will be supercritical when

options.html: the ripples move in both upstream and downstream direction
options.text: the ripples move in both upstream and downstream direction

options.html: the ripples are swept away downstream
options.text: the ripples are swept away downstream

questions.explanationHtml:
(d)
For supercritical flow, the flow disturbance ripples travel downstream only.
For subcritical flow, the flow disturbance ripples travel both upstream and downstream.
